title: Higher-Dimensional Cancellation for Affine Domains
exact_target: Let $k$ be algebraically closed and let $A$ be a finitely generated $k$-domain of dimension $d>2$. If adjoining $m>0$ polynomial variables gives $A[t_1,\ldots,t_m]\cong k[x_1,\ldots,x_{m+d}]$, must $A$ already be a polynomial ring in $d$ variables over $k$?
